locators.section: P03 — Eligibility (all E1–E7 must be established for INCLUDE)
locators.quote: Eligible preprints are a protocol choice inherited explicitly from protocol.md section4.1, not a new database.

checks.finding: E1–E4 eligibility rules match approved_plan.md (no inference of unclear multi-UAV settings; explicit collaborative/distributed DNN inference). However, E7's inclusion of non-peer-reviewed preprints and demo/poster/work-in-progress short reports is a protocol policy choice rather than a requirement stated in approved_plan.md (whose course PDF cites journal/conference papers), relies on protocol.md section4.1 which is not in the supplied audit files, and lacks an explicit minimum operational threshold for substantive method and evaluation on short reports.
checks.required_correction: Confirm with user whether non-peer-reviewed preprints and demo/poster/work-in-progress short reports are eligible in the restart scope (and verify protocol.md section4.1 if retained), or restrict E7 to peer-reviewed journal/conference full reports; if short reports are retained, define explicit minimum method/evaluation thresholds.

locators.quote: A sought report that cannot be retrieved is NOT_RETRIEVED, separate from an assessed full-text exclusion. An abstract-only publication type is different from failure to retrieve an otherwise full report.

checks.finding: P06 cleanly separates missing-abstract records (forwarded as UNCLEAR), unretrieved sought reports (NOT_RETRIEVED), and verified abstract-only publication types (ineligible under E7), and restricts PDF reuse to independently rediscovered and verified records.

locators.section: P06 — Selection and retrieval (steps07–09)
locators.quote: Decisions are INCLUDE, EXCLUDE or AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION. For EXCLUDE store one primary reason and any secondary flags.

checks.finding: Full-text decisions (INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION), single primary exclusion reason with secondary flags, and exact locator requirements match approved_plan.md; the 7-step exclusion priority order is a protocol policy choice consistent with storing one primary reason.

locators.section: P07 — Reports and study families (step10)
locators.quote: A merge requires evidence from both reports, such as explicit version linkage, shared experiment/cohort/dataset design with an established relationship or author statement. locators.section: P09 — Appraisal (step12)
